product_overview: OnlyWorkshop is a web platform to discover local creative workshops and book seats with a streamlined checkout and host/admin tools. It provides auth-protected bookings, host onboarding, admin analytics, feedback collection, and transactional notifications.
core_goals: Allow users to discover, view details for, and book creative workshops with a seamless payment flow.
Provide secure user authentication and profile management with persistent sessions.
Enable hosts to apply and admins to manage workshops and view platform analytics.
Collect attendee feedback and send transactional / scheduled email notifications.
Keep the system production-ready and resilient with clear error conditions for external service failures.

features.name: Workshop Discovery and Booking
features.description: Browse available workshops, inspect detailed workshop pages, create bookings (auth required), and complete payment via checkout sessions. Includes handling of post-payment notification events.
user_flows: GET /api/workshops -> Receive 200 with Workshop[] -> GET /api/workshops/{id} -> Receive 200 with Workshop -> GET /api/auth/me with valid session token -> Receive 200 with User -> POST /api/bookings with Authorization and body {"workshopId": "{id}", "seats": 2} -> Receive 200 with Booking -> POST /api/bookings/checkout with Authorization and body {"bookingId": "{bookingId}"} -> Receive 200 with CheckoutSession -> POST /api/internal/payments/events with X-OnlyWorkshop-Signature and body {event: 'payment.succeeded', ...} -> Receive 200 stored event
POST /api/bookings without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/bookings/checkout with Authorization and invalid or expired bookingId -> Receive 400 Payment error

features.name: Authentication and Profile
features.description: Support session-aware authentication checks and profile retrieval/update for the current user. (Auth performed via Supabase client on frontend; server exposes session-aware endpoints.)
user_flows: GET /api/auth/me with valid session token -> Receive 200 with User -> GET /api/profile with Authorization -> Receive 200 with UserProfile -> PUT /api/profile with Authorization and body {"name": "New Name", "phone": "9999999999"} -> Receive 200 with updated UserProfile
GET /api/auth/me without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> PUT /api/profile with Authorization and invalid body (missing required name) -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Host Applications and Admin Management
features.description: Allow logged-in users to submit host onboarding applications; provide admin endpoints to list workshops and fetch aggregate stats for the admin dashboard.
user_flows: POST /api/host-applications with Authorization and body {"name":"Jane Doe","phone":"9999999999","experience":"5 years"} -> Receive 200 with HostApplication -> GET /api/admin/workshops with admin Authorization -> Receive 200 with Workshop[] -> GET /api/admin/stats with admin Authorization -> Receive 200 with AdminStats

POST /api/host-applications with Authorization and malformed body (missing phone) -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /api/admin/workshops with non-admin or missing Authorization -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Feedback and Notifications
features.description: Authenticated attendees can submit workshop feedback; public feedback can be read without auth. Admins can trigger scheduled transactional emails. System handles failures when email or external services are down.
user_flows: POST /api/workshops/{id}/feedback with Authorization and body {"rating": 5, "comment": "Loved it!"} -> Receive 200 with Feedback -> GET /api/workshops/{id}/public-feedback -> Receive 200 with Feedback[] (includes the new feedback)
POST /api/workshops/{id}/feedback without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/cron/emails with admin Authorization when email provider fails -> Receive 500 Internal error

known_limitations.issue: Some API endpoints rely on external services (Supabase, Resend, Razorpay) and may fail if environment variables are missing or services are unavailable.
known_limitations.impact: Runtime errors or failed network requests in non-production or misconfigured environments.

known_limitations.issue: Rate limiting and abuse protection are minimal for several public-facing endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: High-volume traffic could cause degraded performance or abuse without additional safeguards.
